verifiedAgainst: Merged createBackend (electron/backend.ts) with injected native/shell/fetch/confirm mocks; no real desktop input, no network, no Electron.

assistantChat: System notes the backend stores instead of rejecting are now typed: 'Local/Cloud model unavailable: <reason>' (danger, with System status + Check again), 'Stopped by you.' (info), 'The connection ended before the reply was finished.' (warn). Previously every system note was titled 'The model did not answer'.
A partial reply followed by a stopped/incomplete note gets an 'Incomplete' badge.
Model route panel and the waiting indicator report the backend's own reasons for chat-streaming and chat-cancel (both unavailable); no stop button and no fake streaming.
intentFlow: Execution refusals are typed (declined native confirmation, expired/used preview, paused confirmations, rate limit, safe launch) and explained as 'Nothing ran', with the backend's wording kept visible.
An unknown/expired/used preview on execute is a definite 'not run', not 'unconfirmed'. Unknown thrown errors and bare resolved promises stay 'unconfirmed'.
Waiting state while the Windows confirmation is open; approval is disabled and 'Preview again' offered once a preview is older than 59 s (backend TTL is 60 s).

Copy states that the trusted Windows confirmation (Cancel default) decides; the in-page dialog in Computer no longer says 'This runs ... right after you approve' and its button reads 'Approve & continue to Windows'.
changes.contractsUnchanged: No JarvisAPI/contract change. CommandStep.outcome gained an optional 'cause' (renderer-local type).

checks.npm test: 591 tests, 587 pass, 0 fail, 4 pre-existing TODO (route deep links / Routines / Integrations reachability: owned by shell, not this module)

streamingProposal.status: Not implemented in the UI: JarvisAPI has no stream/cancel methods; getApiInfo reports chat-streaming and chat-cancel as unavailable. ChatService (electron/services/chat.ts: start(text,{onDelta}) -> {id,cancel,done}; cancel(id?)) already exists and is not wired.

proposal.contracts: chatStart?(text:string):Promise<{id:string}>; chatCancel?(id?:string):Promise<boolean>; onChatDelta?(handler:(e:{id:string;delta:string})=>void):()=>void; onChatDone?(handler:(e:{id:string;message:ChatMessage})=>void):()=>void. All optional, like the other v2 methods.
proposal.backend: chatStart wraps ChatService.start: push onDelta to the renderer over a jarvis:chatDelta event, resolve done to jarvis:chatDone with the stored final ChatMessage (system note for stop/incomplete/provider errors, as today). Busy start rejects with 'A reply is already being generated. Stop it first'. chatCancel returns ChatService.cancel(id). Keep chat() unchanged for compatibility.
proposal.ipc: Strict arg specs: chatStart [string<=4000], chatCancel [optional string<=100]. Events go only to the sender window from a trusted origin.
proposal.apiInfo: Flip chat-streaming and chat-cancel to available only when the methods are wired.
proposal.uiFollowUp: Assistant.tsx would show the growing reply while pending and a Stop button that calls chatCancel; the already-typed 'Stopped by you' and 'cut off' notes then render without further UI work.

limitations: No stop button or streaming until the proposal above is implemented by the data-api owner.

System notes are typed by the backend's message text (classifyReply). If chat.ts wording changes, the tests in tests/milestone-assistant.test.mjs against the real backend will fail first for 'unavailable'; 'stopped'/'incomplete' are only covered by literal strings because the backend cannot produce them without a stream.
Preview expiry is a renderer timer (59 s) mirroring the backend's 60 s PREVIEW_TTL_MS; the backend remains the authority and its refusal is typed 'expired'.
Computer.tsx imports its shared helpers from Assistant.tsx; moving them to src/ui would need a shell-owner change.
CommandFlow is rendered to static markup in tests (no DOM, effects do not run); the expiry timer itself is not exercised.
No real desktop input, speech, microphone or Electron window was exercised.
